note: Assertion pass counts from graded sonnet subagent runs. old_skill is the skill as first proposed in the PR (bundled guide copy, X1 a SHOULD, O2 preferring curated text); with_skill is the revised skill reading the guide from a local stand-in for the raw URL (eval 2: guide withheld); without_skill is no skill. Grading was done by reading each final answer against the assertions in evals.json; the runs could not write report files, so the answers are not stored.

old_skill: O2 JSON text block reported as a finding
without_skill: no table and fewer than 10 item IDs (eval 1)
no apply_namespace or agent_policy, no credential-boundary finding (eval 4)
